title: LTE CRC Decoder
source_docs: Wireless HDL Toolbox/Error Detection and Correction/LTE_CRC_Decoder.md
text: Detect errors in input samples using checksum, 2 inputs, 3 outputs, {CRC Type} sets Encode polynomial; {Full checksum mismatch} sets the return bit-by-bit mismatch information and {CRC Mask} sets the mask applied to checksum. Values come from the instance.
